source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why should a personal skill's assumptions fit the projects where it is used?

options.text: Personal scope removes the need for a description
options.feedback: A personal skill still needs selection guidance. Broader availability does not replace the required description.

options.text: Each project must produce identical output content
options.feedback: Cross-project reuse concerns the method. Different inputs and purposes can still yield different task outputs.

options.text: Its reusable procedure may be applied across projects
options.feedback: Personal scope supports use beyond one project, so assumptions should suit that broader intended use.

options.text: Each project must store its transcripts inside the skill
options.feedback: Task-specific transcripts belong with their runs. Personal scope does not turn all project inputs into reusable skill content.
